name: nature-skills
description: A growing collection of Claude skills for producing academic work at Nature-journal standard. 22 triggerable skills covering research writing (nature-writing, nature-proposal-writer), manuscript polishing (nature-polishing), reviewer simulation (nature-reviewer), statistics reporting (nature-statistics), citation retrieval/verification (nature-citation, nature-ref-verifier, nature-academic-search), data availability (nature-data), figures (nature-figure), paper reading/translation (nature-reader, nature-paper-xray, nature-paper-card, nature-paper-trans), reviewer responses (nature-response), paper-to-PPTX (nature-paper2ppt, nature-image2ppt), literature pipelines and more. All rules derived from primary sources — published Nature papers, journal author guidelines, and structured writing curricula.
